limitations.text: Findings rely solely on Pinterest internal English-language search data gathered between September 2023 and August 2025, so results may not generalise to non-English users, other platforms or more recent behaviour.
Growth figures are expressed as normalised percentage changes rather than absolute search volumes, which can exaggerate trends that begin from a small baseline.
The document is a marketing publication whose forward-looking 2026 trend predictions have not undergone independent peer review, making their accuracy uncertain.
